faq.title: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.question: Is this a medical diagnosis?
items.answer: DiagnoCare provides decision support to guide your care, but does not replace the advice of a healthcare professional.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. All information is encrypted and does not leave your device without your explicit consent.

items.question: How does the AI work?
items.answer: Our AI compares your symptoms to thousands of validated cases to propose precise diagnostic hypotheses.

items.question: Can I share the results with my doctor?
items.answer: You can export a summary of your evaluation and easily send it to your doctor.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: The application offers a 100% free basic version, though the introduction of premium features is not ruled out.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introduction: Welcome to DiagnoCare. By using our platform, you agree to these terms of service. Please read them carefully before using our services. DiagnoCare is an AI-powered medical decision support tool designed to guide patients in their care journey.

usage.title: Service Usage Terms
usage.content: DiagnoCare is intended for adults wishing to obtain a preliminary evaluation of their symptoms. You agree to provide accurate and up-to-date information during registration and use of the service. Abusive, fraudulent use or use for unauthorized commercial purposes is strictly prohibited. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate any account in case of violation of these terms.

responsibilities.title: User Responsibilities
responsibilities.content: As a user, you are responsible for the confidentiality of your login credentials. You agree not to share your account with third parties. You acknowledge that the results provided by DiagnoCare are for informational purposes only and do not substitute professional medical advice. Any medical decision must be made in consultation with a qualified healthcare professional.

medical_disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
medical_disclaimer.content: DiagnoCare is a decision support tool and does not constitute a medical diagnosis. The results and recommendations provided are based on artificial intelligence algorithms and do not replace the advice of a doctor, pharmacist, or any other healthcare professional. In case of medical emergency, please immediately contact emergency services or go to the nearest emergency room.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: DiagnoCare and its developers shall not be held liable for direct or indirect consequences resulting from the use of the platform. This includes, but is not limited to, medical decisions made based on results provided by the application, service interruptions, data loss, or any other damage related to the use of the service.

modifications.title: Terms Modifications
modifications.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms of service at any time. Modifications will take effect upon publication on the platform. It is your responsibility to regularly review the terms of service. Continued use of the service after modification constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For any questions regarding these terms of service, you can contact us by email at support@diagnocare.com or through the contact form available on our platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: At DiagnoCare, protecting your personal and health data is our absolute priority. This privacy policy describes how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our AI-powered diagnostic support platform.

data_collection.title: Data Collection
data_collection.content: We collect the information you provide during registration (name, first name, email address), your patient profile data (age, gender, medical history, chronic conditions, allergies, and current treatments), the symptom data you enter during your evaluations, as well as technical connection data (IP address, browser type, operating system). No data is collected without your explicit consent.

data_usage.title: Data Usage
data_usage.content: Your data is used exclusively to provide you with the DiagnoCare service: symptom analysis, evolution tracking, and personalized recommendations. We use anonymized and aggregated data to improve our artificial intelligence algorithms. Your personal data is never sold or shared for advertising purposes.

data_protection.title: Data Protection
data_protection.content: All your data is encrypted end-to-end using medical-grade security protocols (AES-256, TLS 1.3). Our servers are hosted in Europe and comply with GDPR. Regular security audits are conducted to ensure optimal protection of your information. Access to data is strictly limited to authorized personnel.

data_sharing.title: Data Sharing
data_sharing.content: Your health data is never shared with third parties without your explicit consent. You have the option to export and share your evaluation results with your doctor. In case of a legal request, we may be required to communicate certain information to competent authorities in accordance with applicable law.

your_rights.title: Your Rights
your_rights.content: In accordance with GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, delete, and port your personal data. You can exercise these rights at any time from your account settings or by contacting us directly. You also have the right to withdraw your consent to the processing of your data at any time.

data_retention.title: Data Retention
data_retention.content: Your personal data is retained for the duration of your use of the service. If your account is deleted, your data is permanently removed from our servers within 30 days. Anonymized data used for statistical purposes and algorithm improvement may be retained beyond this period.

contact.title: Data Protection Officer
contact.content: For any questions regarding the protection of your personal data, you can contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) at dpo@diagnocare.com or by mail at the address indicated in the legal notices on our website.
